subject.title: Silent empty tool results in long-running Sonnet 5 sessions after a large tool result

question: Should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99524 be treated as the canonical fix path for this issue's multi-provider silent empty tool-result reports, or should this issue remain separate until provider-bound payload proof confirms the exact mechanism?
rationale: The code path and new field report strongly point at shared prompt projection, but this issue's large-result long-session trigger has not been proven against the candidate PR in an installed session.

options.title: Canonicalize on the open prompt-projection PR
options.body: Use the open PR as the repair path, require maintainer review/rebase as needed, and close this issue only after the PR lands with main or release proof.

options.title: Require provider-payload proof first
options.body: Keep this issue separate until a redacted before/after provider payload or trajectory comparison confirms the candidate PR covers this exact failure.

options.title: Split after the candidate lands
options.body: Land the shared prompt-projection fix first, then open a narrower follow-up only if Sonnet, Anthropic Messages, or Google reports still reproduce.

recommendation.title: Canonicalize on the open prompt-projection PR
recommendation.body: Use the open PR as the repair path, require maintainer review/rebase as needed, and close this issue only after the PR lands with main or release proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the adjacent same-helper protection that this candidate path extends.
